statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and lightheadedness
These symptoms have persisted despite medical management
The patient has known sick sinus syndrome (I49.5)
A mobile cardiac telemetry study (CPT 93229) is ordered
The service is for continuous ambulatory monitoring
The purpose is to evaluate correlation between symptomatic events and potential arrhythmic activity
The diagnosis codes are I49.5 and R42
The denial reason code is PR-204
The denial is based on the service not being covered under the member's current benefit plan
The clinical indication note supports the medical necessity of this service for the diagnoses I49.5 and R42
